tasks.title: Read the mission files and confirm the scaffold is intact
tasks.notes: Start here so the mission loop has a clear first slice.

tasks.title: Create a tiny demo artifact inside the mission directory
validation: grep -qx 'Hello from the demo mission.' devdocs/missions/demo/output/hello.txt
tasks.notes: Keep the artifact fully self-contained under devdocs/missions/demo/output/.

tasks.title: Mark the demo mission complete
validation:
python3 - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
path = Path('devdocs/missions/demo/TASKS.json')
data = json.loads(path.read_text())
assert all(task['status'] == 'done' for task in data['tasks'])
PY
tasks.notes: Set this to done only after the earlier demo tasks are truly complete and PROGRESS.md says the mission is finished.
